titleSq: Duplex në shitje në Mati 1, Prishtinë
titleEn: Duplex for sale in Mati 1, Prishtina
descriptionSq:
Ofrohet per shitje duplex me siperfaqe 112.86 m², me lokacion ne lagjen Kodrina, Mati 1, Prishtine.
Kompleksi Izzy, ndertues Izzy SH.P.K.

Banesa ka orientim Jug-Lindje dhe ka kete renditje te hapesirave te brendshme: qendrim ditor, kuzhine, dy dhoma gjumi, 3 banjo, depo dhe nje ballkon.
Ndodhet ne katin e 1 & 2.
Kontrata behet tek noteri direkt me kompanine ndertuese.
Sistemi i ngrohjes eshte me rryme elektrike.

Banesa ndodhet ne nje zone me potencial zhvillimi, afer sherbimeve publike dhe private.
Po ashtu ne cmim perfshihet edhe nje garazhe private.
descriptionEn:
A duplex of 112.86 m² is offered for sale, located in the Kodrina neighbourhood, Mati 1, Prishtina.
Izzy complex, builder Izzy SH.P.K.

The apartment faces South-East and has the following layout of interior spaces: living room, kitchen, two bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a storage room and one balcony.
It is located on floors 1 & 2.
The contract is signed at the notary directly with the construction company.

The apartment is located in an area with development potential, near public and private services.
A private garage is also included in the price.
